examples.en: My phone is out of battery.
Phone me when you get home.

mnemonic.tip: on the phone 在通话中；phone sb = call sb 给某人打电话。

examples.en: I'll call you after dinner.
Everyone calls him Tom.

mnemonic.tip: call back 回电话；be called 被称作——What is it called? 这叫什么？

examples.en: Text me when you arrive.
Read the text and answer the questions.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：手机短信和阅读课文——都是"文字"。

examples.en: There is a message for you on the table.
Can I leave a message for Mr Green?
examples.zh: 我能给格林先生留个言吗？

mnemonic.tip: leave a message 留言，send a message 发消息——KET 写作常考写 message。

examples.en: I found the answer on the internet.
The internet is not working today.

mnemonic.tip: inter(互相)+net(网)→把全世界连起来的网，就是互联网；on the internet 在网上。

examples.en: The school website has the exam dates.
examples.zh: 学校网站上有考试日期。

examples.en: This website teaches English with games.
examples.zh: 这个网站用游戏教英语。

mnemonic.tip: web(网)+site(地点)→网上的一个"地点"，就是网站。

examples.en: I do my project on the computer.
The computer room is next to the library.
examples.zh: 电脑教室在图书馆旁边。

mnemonic.tip: compute(计算)+r→会计算的机器，就是电脑。

examples.en: Dad takes his laptop to work.
examples.zh: 爸爸带笔记本电脑去上班。

examples.en: Her laptop is thin and light.
examples.zh: 她的笔记本电脑又薄又轻。

mnemonic.tip: lap(大腿)+top(上面)→放在大腿上用的电脑，就是笔记本。

examples.en: Don't sit too close to the screen.
The cinema has a huge screen.
examples.zh: 电影院有一块巨大的银幕。

mnemonic.tip: screen time 屏幕时间——爸妈最爱管的就是它。

examples.en: She types fast on the keyboard.
The keyboard has a hundred keys.

mnemonic.tip: key(键)+board(板)→布满按键的板子，就是键盘；钢琴键盘也叫它。

examples.en: The printer is out of paper.
Print your project on the school printer.
examples.zh: 用学校的打印机打印你的课题。

mnemonic.tip: print(打印)+er(机器)→打印的机器，就是打印机。

examples.en: Click on the picture to see more.
Click the green button to start the game.

mnemonic.tip: 鼠标"咔嗒(click)"一声——click 本身就是点击的声音。

examples.en: I learn words with an English app.
examples.zh: 我用一个英语 App 记单词。

examples.en: This app is free to download.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以免费下载。

mnemonic.tip: app 是 application 的简称：手机里一个个小方块图标。

examples.en: We chatted about the film for an hour.
examples.zh: 我们聊那部电影聊了一个小时。

examples.en: Grandma likes chatting with the neighbours.

mnemonic.tip: chat 是轻松闲聊；网上聊天也是 chat——聊天软件叫 chat app。

words.meaning: 说（语言）；讲话（过去式 spoke）

examples.en: Do you speak English?
Can I speak to Anna, please?
examples.zh: 请问安娜在吗？（电话用语）

mnemonic.tip: speak+语言（speak English）；打电话找人说 Can I speak to…?

examples.en: What did the teacher say?
She said sorry to her friend.

mnemonic.tip: say 强调说的内容；said 读 /sed/ 不读 /seɪd/。

examples.en: Tell me about your holiday!
Grandpa told us a funny story.
examples.zh: 爷爷给我们讲了个有趣的故事。

mnemonic.tip: tell 后面接人：tell me；say 后面接内容——tell sb sth。

examples.en: We talked about our favourite games.
examples.zh: 我们聊了各自最喜欢的游戏。

examples.en: Don't talk in the library.

mnemonic.tip: talk to sb 和某人说话，talk about sth 谈论某事。

examples.en: Listen to the teacher carefully.
I listen to music on the way home.

mnemonic.tip: listen 的 t 不发音；listen to+对象——主动去听。

examples.en: Can you hear the birds singing?
I heard a knock at the door.

mnemonic.tip: hear 里有 ear(耳朵)：声音自己进耳朵是 hear，主动去听是 listen。

examples.en: Don't shout. I can hear you.
The fans shouted the team's name.
examples.zh: 球迷们高喊球队的名字。

mnemonic.tip: shout 读的时候嘴要张得大大的——这个词本身就像在喊。

examples.en: Could you repeat that, please?
Repeat the new words after me.

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+peat→再来一次，就是重复；听不清就说 Could you repeat that?

examples.en: What does this word mean?
A red light means 'stop'.

mnemonic.tip: What do you mean? 你什么意思？——听不懂就这么问。

examples.en: The singer has a beautiful voice.
Please speak in a quiet voice.

mnemonic.tip: voice 是人发出的嗓音；物体的声音用 sound。

examples.en: I heard a strange sound in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我听见厨房里有奇怪的声音。

examples.en: That sounds like a great idea!

mnemonic.tip: Sounds good! 听起来不错——口语答应别人的高频句。

examples.en: I have some good news for you!
Dad watches the news at seven.

mnemonic.tip: news 以 s 结尾却不可数：a piece of news 一条消息。

examples.en: Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.
Our school has its own newspaper.
examples.zh: 我们学校有自己的校报。

mnemonic.tip: news(新闻)+paper(纸)→印新闻的纸，就是报纸。

examples.en: The website has information about the zoo.
examples.zh: 网站上有关于动物园的信息。

examples.en: For more information, call this number.
examples.zh: 了解更多信息请拨打这个号码。

mnemonic.tip: information 不可数：some information，不说 an information。

examples.en: Put a stamp on the envelope.
He collects stamps from different countries.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"死贴"：邮票要用力贴在信封上。

examples.en: Write the address on the envelope.
The card is inside a red envelope.

mnemonic.tip: envelope 把信"包(envelop)"起来的纸袋；红包就是 red envelope。

examples.en: We had a long conversation about football.
Listen to the conversation and answer.

mnemonic.tip: KET 听力题干常见：Listen to the conversation 听对话。

examples.en: Dear Anna, thank you for your letter.
examples.zh: 亲爱的安娜，谢谢你的来信。

examples.en: Oh dear! I forgot my keys.

mnemonic.tip: 写信第一行 Dear+名字；Oh dear! 表示"哎呀"。

examples.en: She writes a blog about her school life.
examples.zh: 她写关于学校生活的博客。

examples.en: I read a blog about pet care.
examples.zh: 我读了一篇关于养宠物的博客。

mnemonic.tip: blog = web log(网络日志)的缩写：网上的日记本。

examples.en: I downloaded a new game last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚下载了一个新游戏。

examples.en: You can download the songs for free.

mnemonic.tip: down(下)+load(装载)→把东西从网上"装下来"，就是下载。

examples.en: Don't tell anyone your password.
I forgot the wifi password again.
examples.zh: 我又忘了 wifi 密码。

mnemonic.tip: pass(通过)+word(词)→让你"通过"的暗语，就是密码。

examples.en: The children read e-books on tablets.
examples.zh: 孩子们在平板上看电子书。

examples.en: Take one tablet after meals.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：小平板电脑和小药片——都是扁扁的一片。

examples.en: I posted the letter this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上把信寄出去了。

examples.en: She posted photos of her cat online.
examples.zh: 她在网上发了她猫的照片。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：寄信和网上发帖——都是把内容"发出去"。

examples.en: Send me a photo of your new bike!
examples.zh: 把你新自行车的照片发给我！

examples.en: She sent a card to her grandma.
examples.zh: 她给奶奶寄了一张卡片。

mnemonic.tip: send→sent→sent；send sb sth 给某人发某物。

examples.en: Please reply to my email soon.
I asked twice, but he didn't reply.
examples.zh: 我问了两次，他都没回答。

mnemonic.tip: re(回)+ply→把话"折回去"，就是回复；reply to 回复某人。

examples.en: There is a notice about the trip on the board.
examples.zh: 布告栏上有关于出游的通知。

examples.en: I noticed a new student in class.
examples.zh: 我注意到班里来了个新同学。

mnemonic.tip: KET 阅读第一题常是读 notice(告示)选意思。

examples.en: I saw an advert for the new film.
examples.zh: 我看到了那部新电影的广告。

examples.en: There are too many adverts on TV.

mnemonic.tip: advert 是 advertisement 的英式简称，口语更常说 ad。

examples.en: Use headphones on the bus, please.
My new headphones sound great.

mnemonic.tip: head(头)+phones(听筒)→戴在头上的听筒，就是耳机，成对用复数。
